name: baoyu-design-system
description: Builds a design system from a code repository, a design tool or scratch: tokens, type, components, assets and a brand book, as files in your workspace, in a page that runs on your computer where you can browse and edit them. Baoyu Slides and Baoyu Canvas can install what it makes. Runs locally on Node.js 20 or later.
